Dean's Dissertation Fellowship
Process & Timeline
Committee Review Considerations
Award:
Stipend - $30,833
Graduate fellow health benefits
Awarded each spring semester
Eligibility:
GSN Ph.D. students at the dissertation writing stage
Students in good academic standing who have completed all coursework and research credits
Completed application submitted no later than December 1, 2026
​
Completion Requirement:
Fellows must be ready to defend their dissertation and complete all graduation requirements by April 1st of the award year.
Applications: Access in Canvas Hub

Travel & Professional Learning Grant
​*Travel grant cycle table
Award:​
Regional: up to $1000
National: up to $1200
International: up to $1500
Students may apply to multiple cycles per awarding year; however, GSN will fund up to two travels and no more than a total of $2000 per awarding year.
Eligibility: ​​
Currently enrolled GSN Ph.D and master's students
Selection Priority: Given to students who have not been funded in recent cycles; who have demonstrated engagement with University and GSN professional learning programs; and who are in the first five (5) years of their academic programs.
​
Completion requirements:
All approved travel receipts must be submitted within 30 days after the conclusion of the event to receive reimbursement.
NOTE: The travel grant does not reimburse for food.
Applications: Access in Canvas Hub
